get.description: Liveness: the process is up and serving requests.
Readiness: every backing service (Postgres, Redis) answers.

delete.description:
Delete the account and all its data (GDPR). The identity-provider account is deleted
by the client with its own SDK.

put.description:
Where the user lives: currency, price estimates, dates. Moving to a region with another
currency also switches the goals' currency (the budget amount is kept).

get.description: Everything stored about the user, as JSON (GDPR data portability).

put.description: Refuses unsafe or impossible targets (calorie floor, max deficit vs estimated needs).
Hard constraints: no planned recipe will contain these (enforced by the solver, M3).

get.description: Cuisines of the shared catalogue (never of users' own recipes), for preference pickers.
A page of foods for `q`; a full page means there may be more (next `offset`).

parameters.name: scope

schema.description: generic: foods only, no packaged products (allergies, preferences)
schema.title: Scope

parameters.description: generic: foods only, no packaged products (allergies, preferences)

get.description:
A product by its barcode (EAN-13, EAN-8, UPC-A): from the catalogue, else from Open Food
Facts (stored, so the next scan is local). Only the barcode leaves the app.

post.description: Queue a receipt photo for reading. The photo is deleted as soon as it has been read.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo

post.description: Queue pasted receipt text (e.g. from an online order) for reading.

415.description: Not a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo

get.description: The 20 most recent uploads, newest first.

delete.description:
Delete the upload, its photo (if not yet read) and its lines. Pantry items already
confirmed from it stay.

patch.description: Edit a suggestion before confirming: food, quantity + unit, use-by date, or status.

post.description:
Add every line that isn't rejected and has a food to the pantry (source `receipt`,
approximate where the size wasn't printed); suggested lines become accepted. Lines without
a food are skipped. 409 unless the receipt is ready (so confirming twice adds nothing).

get.description:
Soonest-expiring first; items without a date last. Used-up items (0 g left after meals
were marked eaten) are kept for undo but not listed.

Expiry alerts: items with something left whose use-by date is before `today` + `days`
(so days=3 means today, tomorrow and the day after), expired ones included, soonest
first.

parameters.name: today

schema.description: The user's local date (default: today in their time zone)
schema.title: Today

parameters.description: The user's local date (default: today in their time zone)

400.description: bad start date, or no plan fits (reasons)

409.description: setup incomplete (goals, allergies, preferences) or goals need review

503.description: the planner found no plan in time

post.description:
Apply plan changes (skip, swap, craving, food eaten off-plan) without the chat: the
chat's executor, so the same rules, results and new plan version. Server-Timing has the
replan's wall time.

409.description: busy: a plan change (chat or plan screen) is running; duplicate: this client_id was already applied (reload the plan)

get.description:
The plan in force on `date` (the newest version covering it, else the newest plan), or
null if there is none. Next week's plan doesn't replace this week's for this week's dates.
The plan for the days after the current one ends ("next week"), or null.

A few safe recipes to swap a planned meal for (then POST /plans/replan with a swap and
its recipe_id): ranked like recipe search, not already planned that day, close to the
meal's energy first.

post.description:
Bring back the version before the last change (as a new version: history is kept).
Only the newest version of a week can be undone, only when it came from a change to that
week, and not once food has been logged or meals marked eaten since that change.

409.description: nothing to undo, or too late

post.description:
Mark a meal of the current plan eaten: logged as eaten (counted by later replans, its
slot kept) and its ingredients taken from the pantry. Repeating it changes nothing.

400.description: `today` is implausible, or `date` is after it

404.description: no such plan (or not yours), date not in it, or no meal there

409.description: the plan isn't the latest version (reload it)

delete.description:
Undo a meal marked eaten: the log is voided and the pantry gets back exactly what it
gave (items deleted since are not recreated). Undoing twice changes nothing.

400.description: `today` is implausible, or `date` is after it

404.description: no such plan (or not yours), date not in it, or no meal there

409.description: the plan isn't the latest version (reload it)

post.description:
Move bought lines into the pantry (default: every ticked line not moved yet), in grams,
with a suggested use-by date. Each line moves once; staples are never moved.

get.description:
Plannable recipes safe for the user (allergies, diet, avoided foods; never ones they
blocked), matching `q` if given, ranked like the chat's search: match, then preference
(favourites first), then pantry use.

put.description:
Favourite a recipe (planned more often) or never plan it again; replaces any earlier
verdict. Plans already made keep it until the next plan or replan.

get.description:
A recipe with allergens and suitable diets derived the same way the planner derives them
(never TheMealDB's category, which isn't a diet claim). Signing in is optional: a generated
recipe is only found by its owner.

The latest thread's messages (oldest first, `limit` before `before_id`), whether a reply
is pending, and the user's model availability (key, budget) and message count.

post.description: Start a fresh conversation (earlier ones are kept for export).

Stream the reply as server-sent events (each `data:` is one ChatEvent as JSON).

The turn runs detached (larder_api.chat.tasks): this only relays its events, so a dropped
connection doesn't stop the turn; the client reloads GET /chat/thread (pending) instead of
resending.

404.description: thread_not_found: no such thread (or not yours)

409.description: busy: still answering a message; duplicate: this client_id was already answered

get.description: Weigh-ins of the last `days` days, oldest first.

put.description: Record (or replace) the weigh-in of a day, at most a day ahead of the user's today.

items.title: Items
items.description: The foods in it, one per item, when you can tell them apart.

AteOffPlan.title: AteOffPlan
AteOffPlan.description: The user ate (or will eat) something that isn't in the plan.

file.title: File
file.description: Photo of the receipt: JPEG, PNG or WebP

ChangeResult.title: ChangeResult
ChangeResult.description: One requested change (by its position in the request) and what became of it.

client_id.title: Client Id
client_id.description: the client's id for this message: resending is safe

thread_id.title: Thread Id
thread_id.description: omit to continue the latest thread

today.title: Today
today.description: the user's local date (dates like 'tonight' resolve to it)

local_time.title: Local Time
local_time.description: the user's local time: today's meals whose time has passed count as eaten

plan_id.title: Plan Id
plan_id.description: last plan version this turn created

ChatProblem.title: ChatProblem
ChatProblem.description: Body of the chat gate's 400/404/409/429 answers.

recipe_id.title: Recipe Id
recipe_id.description: This exact recipe (an id returned by search_recipes or create_recipe).

strength.title: Strength
strength.description: hard: the user insists; fail and say why if no safe match fits the plan. soft: a preference; keep the plan if nothing suitable fits.

Craving.title: Craving
Craving.description: The user wants something particular at a meal ("something spicy tonight").

DayKcal.title: DayKcal
DayKcal.description: A changed day's new total against the band it was planned to.

status.title: Status
status.description: against the daily kcal goal; null when nothing is logged

DiaryDayOut.title: DiaryDayOut

today.title: Today
today.description: the user's local date (a later `date` is refused)

EatenIn.title: EatenIn
EatenIn.description: Mark a planned meal eaten: a meal of the plan, on or before the user's today.

changed.title: Changed
changed.description: false: it already was in this state (a repeat)

meal.description: the plan's meal at that cell, if any

EatenOut.title: EatenOut
EatenOut.description:
A meal's eaten state after marking (or undoing) it. No new plan version is made: reload
the plan and the pantry to see them.

ExpiringPantry.title: ExpiringPantry
ExpiringPantry.description:
Pantry items with something left whose use-by date is before `today` + `days`, soonest
first (expired ones included).

FoodUnit.title: FoodUnit
FoodUnit.description: A unit the user can enter for this food, with its weight when one unit is known.

Logged.title: Logged
Logged.description:
Food recorded as eaten off-plan, a skipped meal (counted as eaten elsewhere or not), or a
planned meal marked eaten from the plan screen.

MacrosOut.title: MacrosOut
MacrosOut.description:
Energy and macros as whole numbers (kcal, grams). Fibre, sugars, saturated fat and salt
(sodium x 2.5) come from recipes, one decimal; null when unknown. Day and week totals add
planned meals only (food logged off-plan has energy and macros, not these).

MealLogOut.title: MealLogOut
MealLogOut.description:
Food eaten off-plan, a planned meal skipped (told to the chat), or a meal marked eaten
that this version no longer plans, as snapshotted with the plan version: `DayOut.totals` =
its meals + these. A meal marked eaten that the version still plans shows as that meal
(`MealOut.status` eaten), not here.

locked.title: Locked
locked.description: pinned by the user (a craving or swap)

quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: '2 slices', '300 g', '1 large'. Omit if unknown.

OutcomeOut.title: OutcomeOut
OutcomeOut.description: What one plan change request did (also sent live as the `outcome` event).

remaining_quantity.title: Remaining Quantity
remaining_quantity.description: the item's quantity now; null = the item was deleted since (undo: nothing was given back)

PantryChangeOut.title: PantryChangeOut
PantryChangeOut.description: Pantry food a meal marked eaten used (or, on undo, gave back), in the item's own unit.

waste_g.title: Waste G
waste_g.description: pantry food that will expire unused within the plan

start.title: Start
start.description: first day (the user's local date, from yesterday to a week ahead); defaults to today (UTC)

Problems.title: Problems
Problems.description: 422 body for domain-rule failures (e.g. unsafe calorie targets).

ReceiptLineOut.title: ReceiptLineOut
ReceiptLineOut.description:
A line read from the receipt and the pantry entry suggested for it. `food` is null when
nothing matched (pick one with PATCH). `match_method`: receipt | alias | trigram | partial
(a shorter phrase of the name matched) | user.

ReceiptLinePatch.title: ReceiptLinePatch
ReceiptLinePatch.description:
Change a suggestion. Setting `food_id` re-estimates the amount for that food unless a
quantity and unit are given too; any edit makes the line `edited`. `status`: accepted,
rejected, or back to suggested.

ReceiptOut.title: ReceiptOut
ReceiptOut.description:
Poll while `status` is queued or processing. ready: review `lines`; failed: `error`
says why (the photo is already deleted); confirmed: lines are in the pantry.

ReferenceIntakes.title: ReferenceIntakes
ReferenceIntakes.description:
Daily guides (UK/EU reference intakes; fibre: UK advice), shown for context, not planned
for: fibre at least, the rest at most.

client_id.title: Client Id
client_id.description: the client's id for this request: resending is safe

local_time.title: Local Time
local_time.description: the user's local time: today's meals whose time has passed count as eaten

ReplanRequest.title: ReplanRequest
ReplanRequest.description:
Plan changes made from the plan screen (no chat): the same typed changes the chat's
model and offline parser produce, applied by the same executor.

cost_minor.title: Cost Minor
cost_minor.description: share of total_minor; lines sum exactly to the total

stocked.title: Stocked
stocked.description: bought and moved into the pantry

staple.title: Staple
staple.description: store-cupboard item to check you have; no grams or cost

total_minor.title: Total Minor
total_minor.description: estimated cost of every non-staple line (= plan cost)

eating_elsewhere.title: Eating Elsewhere
eating_elsewhere.description: true only if the user said they'll eat somewhere else (eating out, at a friend's, takeaway): a meal of the same size is counted. false if they won't eat (not hungry, fasting) or didn't say. Never change it to make a re-plan succeed.

Skip.title: Skip
Skip.description: The user won't eat a planned meal (eating out, not hungry, away).

Slot.title: Slot
Slot.description: A meal of the day, in eating order.

SlotChange.title: SlotChange
SlotChange.description: One meal that differs between the parent and the new plan version (recipe or size).

StockIn.title: StockIn
StockIn.description: Lines to move into the pantry; default: every ticked line not moved yet.

Swap.title: Swap
Swap.description: Replace a planned meal with something else, optionally something particular.

TargetsOut.title: TargetsOut
TargetsOut.description: What the planner aimed for: per-day bands, whole-plan bands, and the calorie floor.

TextResetEvent.title: TextResetEvent
TextResetEvent.description: Discard the reply text streamed so far (a declined or dropped model response).

pending.description: a reply is still being worked on

llm_available.title: Llm Available
llm_available.description: false: replies come from the offline parser

ViolationOut.title: ViolationOut
ViolationOut.description:
A rule the plan misses. `hard` ones (kcal band, budget, repeats) come only from the
baseline planner; soft ones (protein/fat/carbs bands) are trade-offs any planner may make.
Safety rules (allergens, diet, calorie floor) are never broken in a saved plan.

slot.description: breakfast, lunch, dinner or snack. 'Tonight' means dinner.

When.title: When
When.description: A day in the user's own calendar (their local date) and optionally one meal of it.
